key_highlights: ASX poised for downward pressure as Wall Street tech retreat and AI pullback weigh on global equity sentiment.
NAB full-year profit declined to $6.1 billion amid rising recession risks, triggering banking sector weakness.
Iconic department store David Jones enters voluntary administration after failed landlord negotiations, shaking retail and REIT sectors.
RBA signals persistent excess demand and need for higher unemployment, maintaining pressure on borrowing capacity and housing.

sectors.trend: NAB earnings dropped to $6.1B on rising credit impairment risks and economic slowdown concerns.
sectors.implications: Big Four margin compression and asset quality scrutiny will weigh heavily on the ASX 200.

sectors.trend: David Jones collapsed into voluntary administration with widespread store closures expected.
sectors.implications: Severe tenant renegotiation and vacancy headwinds for major retail landlords and shopping centre operators.

sectors.trend: Global AI pullback triggers tech selloff; Canva announces 1,200 layoffs despite NextDC aftermarket volatility.
sectors.implications: Valuation re-rating for high-multiple ASX tech names alongside heightened scrutiny over data centre siting.

sectors.trend: Regulatory relief on select heritage zones aids resource projects, while junior exploration expands in gold and tungsten.
sectors.implications: Resource sector offers relative defensive stability, with gold producers benefiting from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Crude oil volatility driven by US midterm political developments, alongside domestic energy transition cost blowouts.
sectors.implications: Mixed earnings trajectory for domestic energy producers; capital allocation discipline remains critical.

key_themes: Major bank earnings contraction and deteriorating credit conditions.
Retail insolvencies and commercial property vacancy risks.
Global technology valuation corrections spilling into domestic equities.
Monetary policy persistence dampening consumer demand and housing valuations.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Banking Sector Margin & Credit Quality Degradation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight major domestic banks; allocate toward diversified capital-resilient financials.
Rotate exposure away from discretionary retail REITs toward logistics and non-discretionary assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tech Multiple Compression from Global AI Retraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce holdings in high-PE unprofitable tech; concentrate in cash-generative enterprise software.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn & Borrowing Capacity Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid residential builders and mortgage-dependent building product suppliers.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate senior gold producers as portfolio hedges
opportunities.rationale: Gold equities offer defensiveness against equity volatility and slowing macroeconomic momentum.

opportunities.recommendation: Target oversold high-quality data centre operators on pullbacks
opportunities.rationale: Structural cloud and computing demand persists despite near-term planning and tech sentiment friction.
Supermarket grocers demonstrate robust pricing power and defensiveness during consumer retrenchment.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to Big Four banking majors
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB profit drop and elevated recession risks signal broader credit provisioning headwinds.
David Jones administration increases store vacancy rates and threatens base rental yields.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement index-level hedging on the ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Heavyweight drags in financials, tech, and retail will constrain broad index performance.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 faces downside bias testing key technical support as banking earnings and consumer headwinds weigh on sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: A sustainable recovery depends on RBA rate relief once inflation stabilizes and corporate margins normalize through 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate decisions
Big Four bank margin updates and bad debt provision disclosures
Lease renegotiation and asset sales from the David Jones administration process
US tech earnings guidance and post-midterm macroeconomic policy direction
watch_list: NAB, CBA, and WBC net interest margins and loan impairment provisions
Australian quarterly headline and trimmed mean CPI prints
Retail REIT leasing spreads and tenant occupancy rates
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao spot price and global crude benchmarks
